message.title: A message from Gloria
message.body: I'm a junior at UW Informatics working toward AI product management. I like problems where the model is the easy part and the hard part is trust: who did what, what changed, and why the result should be believed. Everything in this cabinet started as a question like that, and I keep the specimens here so they can be looked at, compared, and argued with.
